headline: Select {arm:atlas-m}. It is the only model meeting every quality and latency gate across all tasks.
lede: {arm:atlas-m} clears all eleven criteria while keeping p95 latency under budget across every task. A tighter resolution requirement in troubleshooting would be needed to reconsider {arm:atlas-l} despite its latency breach.

slots.text: Deploy {arm:atlas-m} for all concierge traffic. It satisfies the overall quality floor and all behavioral gates across tasks.
{arm:atlas-l} breaches the latency budget on four tasks. {arm:open-70b} and {arm:brisk-s} fail multiple quality and behavioral gates.
